body:
CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: Spotlight: real Ctrl+T/Cmd+T command palette for the PARENA editor. New stdlib/editor/spotlight.prn: a real, plugin-extensible provider registry (run-providers) with file-search-provider and calculator-provider (reusing expr.prn, the founder's own explicit 'just a plugin' proof case) on the same real signature a third-party mod would use. Hot-swappable via the same drop-in-file+recompile PARENA-mod pattern already used elsewhere in this monorepo, not runtime dynamic loading. New sdl2/gui-held? for Cmd-key detection. Wired into examples/editor_main.c as a real modal overlay (Ctrl+T/Cmd+T, typed query, Up/Down selection, Enter to activate, Escape to close). 13 new assertions, full suite clean, CI green on all 4 jobs including real Windows/macOS builds. PARENA commit ea21508, Apple #16413. session: sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)

⚓ ☃
